memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: It was not your children who saw what he did for you in the wilderness until you arrived at this place, and what he did to the Egyptian army, to its horses and chariots, how he overwhelmed them with the waters of the Red Sea as they were pursuing you, and how the Lord brought lasting ruin on them. It was not your children who saw how he led you in the wilderness until you arrived at this place. - Deut 11:4-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses reminds the people that they, not their children, were the eyewitnesses of God's astonishing power — the parting of the sea, the destruction of Pharaoh's army, the leading through the wilderness. They had seen it with their own eyes. This was not secondhand religion or family tradition; it was firsthand experience of the living God. And because they had seen so much, they bore a responsibility to remember it and to pass it on faithfully to the next generation.

There is a challenge here for anyone who has walked with God for a while. Over time, we accumulate our own experiences of God's faithfulness — answered prayers, unexpected provision, comfort in grief, strength in weakness. These are our "Red Sea" moments, evidence of God at work in our lives. But memories fade if we do not deliberately hold onto them, and the next generation cannot inherit what we fail to pass on.

We are called both to remember and to testify. The psalmist declared, "We will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the Lord" (Ps 78:4). Think back over your own life. What has God done for you that you must not forget? What stories of His faithfulness should you be telling your children, your friends, those younger in the faith? Do not let God's mighty works in your life fade into forgetfulness. Treasure them, speak of them, and let your testimony strengthen the faith of those who come after you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What are the "Red Sea moments" of God's faithfulness in my own life?
- Am I deliberately remembering God's works, or letting them fade?
- Who could I be telling about what God has done for me?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You have worked mightily in my life, and I do not want to forget. Help me treasure the memories of Your faithfulness and testify to them, so that those who come after me may know Your praiseworthy deeds and trust You too. Amen.
